result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_label_from_id()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get the label for a node by its ID. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L3170-L3218){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_label_from_id(node_id) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Translates an internal `u64` node ID to its human-readable string label. Returns `None` if the node doesn't exist or has no label assigned. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [node_id]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The `u64` node ID to look up. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The string label if it exists, or `None` if the node has no label or doesn't exist in the graph. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Retrieve labels for node IDs: ::: {#8ecebf9b .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="Alice") .add_node(label="Bob") ) label = graph.get_label_from_id(1) # Returns "Alice" label ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 'Alice' ``` ::: ::: ::: {#db89b552 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} no_label = graph.get_label_from_id(999) # Returns None no_label ``` :::
